name: Sheet
description: A modal panel that slides in from the edge of the screen, for filters, details or navigation on small screens. Open it with DialogTrigger.

title.description: Heading, also used as the sheet's accessible name.

description.description: Short supporting text under the title.

side.description: The edge it slides in from. end is the right in left-to-right languages.

isDismissable.description: Closes on backdrop click. Esc always closes.

children.description: Body and actions. A function receives close().

keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the sheet
The close button is reachable with Tab
requirements: Focus moves into the sheet on open and returns to the trigger on close
Content behind the sheet is hidden from assistive technology
Page scroll is locked while open
The slide animation is turned off when the user prefers reduced motion
screenReader: Opening announces a dialog with the sheet's title
The description is read after the title
The close button is announced as Close
Closing announces the button that opened it (focus is back there)

use_when: Filters or settings next to the content they affect
Details of a row without leaving the list
avoid_when: Content people need side by side with the page: use a layout panel
anti_patterns: Hiding the only way to close it: keep the close button
